title: 第15章 善缘第16章 一个交代
content_zh:
眼前这位陈渊星主，林云是与他初次见面，他究竟是一个什么样的人，林云现在更是无法做出准确判断。
林云肯定不可能轻易交底。
而且不让陌生人知晓自己的真正来历，也能为自己，增添几分神秘色彩。
宇宙海广袤无垠，势力众多。
在不清楚自己身份、背景的情况下，哪怕是这位陈渊星主，恐怕也不敢贸然对自己不利吧？
他毕竟只是一个初级星系的星主，未必得罪得起宇宙海中的一些强大势力。
还未等林云想好如何应答，陈渊便笑着说道：
“我猜林云道友，应该也是来自初级星系吧？而且……应当是初次进入宇宙海探索，对吧？”
他做出这般判断的原因很简单，林云前往商会购买的东西，是有关宇宙海的资料。
听闻这番话，林云心中猛地一震。
他竟然直接猜中了？
“对，我的确来自一个初级星系，也确实是初来乍到。”
林云微笑着点头承认。
既然对方已然猜到自己来自初级星系，林云也不再隐瞒这一点。
但林云决然不会提及，自己具体来自什么地方。
他只知道自己来自初级星系，倒也无所谓。
“既然林云道友不愿透露的具体，想必是有难言之隐，那我也就不再追问了。”
陈星主微笑着说道。
随后他端起桌上酒杯，轻轻抿了一口：
“林云道友，我邀你前来，别无他意，只是想结下一份善缘。”

林云笑着说道：“陈星主，你刚刚已然猜到，我来自初级星系。”
“像我这种，自初级星系的神境，或许无法为陈星主，带来多大的结交价值吧？”
陈渊同样笑了笑：“林云道友，此言差矣。”
“初级星系资源匮乏，想要崭露头角难度极大。”
“能在初级星系中踏入神境，闯入宇宙海，恰恰足以证明天赋非凡！”
林云听到这话，不禁微微一怔。
这话倒是颇具几分道理。
陈渊抬起头，目光深邃地望向远方：
“当然，还有另一个缘由，你莫要觉得我身为星主，便很风光。
像我们这种初级星系，在幽云宇宙国中，实则地位卑微。”
“幽云宇宙国中，但凡有些名气的势力，都不会对与我结交感兴趣。”
“所以，我也只能，与从初级星系中脱颖而出的神境结交。”
他这番话语的深意，林云自然明白。
content_en:
This is the first time Lin Yun has met Star Master Chen Yuan in front of him. What kind of person he is, Lin Yun is even more unable to make an accurate judgment now.
Lin Yun would definitely not be able to reveal the truth easily.
And not letting strangers know your true origin can also add a bit of mystery to yourself.
The cosmic sea is vast and has many forces.
Without knowing his identity and background, even this Star Master Chen Yuan would not dare to rashly harm himself, right?
After all, he is just the star master of a primary galaxy, and he may not be able to offend some powerful forces in the cosmic sea.
Before Lin Yun could think of how to respond, Chen Yuan smiled and said:
"I guess Fellow Taoist Lin Yun is from a primary galaxy, right? And... it should be the first time he has entered the cosmic sea to explore, right?"
The reason why he made this judgment was simple. The thing Lin Yun went to the Chamber of Commerce to buy was information about the Universe Sea.
Hearing these words, Lin Yun was shocked.
He actually guessed it right?
"Yes, I do come from a primary galaxy, and I am indeed a newbie here."
Lin Yun smiled and nodded in recognition.
Since the other party had already guessed that he was from a primary galaxy, Lin Yun no longer concealed this fact.
But Lin Yun would never mention where he was from.
He only knew that he came from a primary galaxy, which didn't matter.
"Since the details that Fellow Taoist Lin Yun is unwilling to disclose must be hidden, I will not ask further."
Chen Xingzhu said with a smile.
Then he picked up the wine glass on the table and took a sip:
"Fellow Taoist Lin Yun, I invite you here for no other reason than to forge a good relationship."
Lin Yun smiled and said: "Star Master Chen, you have already guessed just now that I come from the primary galaxy."
"For someone like me, who is in the divine realm from the primary galaxy, I may not be able to bring much value to Star Master Chen in making friends, right?"
Chen Yuan also smiled: "Fellow Taoist Lin Yun, this is wrong."
"The resources of the primary galaxy are scarce, and it is extremely difficult to stand out."
"Being able to step into the divine realm and break into the cosmic sea in a primary galaxy is enough to prove your extraordinary talent!"
Lin Yun couldn't help being slightly startled when he heard this.
There is quite a bit of truth in this statement.
Chen Yuan raised his head and looked deeply into the distance:
"Of course, there is another reason. Don't think that as a Star Lord, I am very beautiful.
A primary galaxy like ours actually has a humble status in the Youyun Universe. "
"No matter how famous the forces in Youyun Universe Kingdom are, they will not be interested in making friends with me."
"So, I can only make friends with the gods who stand out from the primary galaxy."
Lin Yun naturally understood the profound meaning of his words.
